title: A Painter Who Draws Dungeons
description: In a world forever changed by the Great Cataclysm, Seo Jio, an ordinary art teacher, dies in a sudden fire and awakens trapped inside a portrait as a painting himself. Within the world of the portrait, Jio gains extraordinary powers that allow him to create life and open gateways to other dimensions. As he travels between worlds and helps people overcome the problems they face, he gradually gets closer to uncovering the truth behind his own mysterious death.
author: Hobby Writing Principle
